parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift`. The two methods resolve structurally similar but semantically distinct entity types (master vs. release), and their similarity (Jaccard 0.71) is attributable to both being test-only mock implementations of the same resolver protocol. Collapsing them into a generic function would couple two separate test targets across package boundaries (`Metadata` and `app:iOS`) for no production benefit. Per decision rule 1, all-test clusters are intentional duplication.
